facts.fact: The Data Protection Commission's Executive Director, Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, spoke at the 8th Privacy Symposium Africa in Accra on 26 November 2026 about the Commission's 2027 targets to strengthen enforcement.

Communications Minister Samuel Nartey George said on 26 November 2026 that Ghana's Data Protection Act, in existence for eight years, is to be reviewed with Parliament's Select Committee on Communication.
The Data Protection Commission's Executive Director said on 26 November 2026 the Commission is setting 2027 targets and will seek legislative reform and stronger enforcement.
